news.title: Proposed Hashdump Constitution
news.content:
Preview the proposed changes here. This is an important guiding document for our club and it has not been revised since Hashdump's creation in 2012. We'll be setting some time from our meeting on November 11th to discuss these proposed changes with attendees.

The timeline for this process is as follows:

Wednesday, November 11th 2026, 6:30 PM
Member feedback for the improved constitution opens.

Wednesday, November 18th 2026
Member feedback closes.

Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Active member voting form on amended proposed constitution based on feedback opens.

Wednesday, December 9th 2026, 6:30 PM in CSB 210
Official vote and counting takes place.

news.title: Hashdump Meeting Times
news.content: Our meetings are on every other Wednesday from 6:30-7:30pm in CSB 210. All majors are welcome, no experience in cybersecurity necessary!  Connect with us over Discord!
